recording.note: This is a territory-specific expiry claim, not CC0 or permission from the record company. The 70-year extension did not revive recordings whose earlier term had already expired by 1 November 2013. It does not establish public-domain status in the United States. The file also carries PD-US-record. Despite its name, that template warns of continuing US protection for historic sound recordings; it is not a US public-domain declaration.
